evidence.source: 中國語言學會期刊資料平台所收論文（2012）
evidence.field: 疑問詞「怎／怎么」的來源與年代討論
evidence.text: 論文回顧數種分析：有研究把唐代《神會語錄》中的「作勿生」「作沒生」視為「怎么」的早期書寫形式，並據《敦煌變文集》記「怎生」五例；另有分析認為「怎」由「作」受「么」聲母影響而變音，怎生則是「怎么生」的縮約。論文同時指出《祖堂集》作「作摩」「作摩生」，《景德傳燈錄》有「怎么」例，將材料排列為八世紀「作勿生、作沒生」、八至十世紀若干變體、十世紀後半以後「怎么、怎」。作者採納語音與語義較能相通的來源說，但文中所述為詞語史研究，不能據此證明「怎」字形本身的最早出現或所有字形演變環節。
evidence.title: 疑问词语“怎么”的来源及相关问题

evidence.source: Doosho transcription of 呂叔湘, 近代漢語指代詞
evidence.field: 怎與爭、作麽生的關係
evidence.text: 此書稱「爭」約八世紀出現且來源未明，並討論「作麽生」與「爭」或「怎生」語音可通；提出「怎生」可能來自「作麽生」（「怎」為「作麽」合音），但明言兩形式年代相近，難判先後。這與把作勿／作沒直接縮合為怎的分析並非完全相同，應保留為競爭或並存的詞源解釋。
evidence.title: 近代漢語指代詞

gaps: No visually inspected manuscript or inscription containing 怎 was found; this research therefore does not establish its earliest graphic form, exact first attestation as a graph, or intermediate graphic changes/corruption.

The reported eighth-century 作勿生／作沒生 forms and later 怎生、作摩、作麼 forms are cited in a secondary study to historical texts. The manuscripts/editions themselves were not inspected, so dates and readings remain reported datings rather than direct primary-source verification.

The proposed lexical path from 作 + 物 to 怎／怎麼 is disputed against analyses involving 作麽生 and the independently occurring interrogative 爭; the semantic and phonological transitions are not fully established by the accessed sources.

No evidence here shows that 怎 is a whole-graph phonetic loan. The evidence instead supports a graphic analysis of 心 semantic plus 乍 phonetic, alongside separate proposed lexical histories for the spoken interrogative forms.

Local Baxter–Sagart table rows were not available among the supplied inputs and were not read from the checkout. The cited /*[dz]ˤrak-s/ for 乍 is the opened secondary page's notation, not a verified local row; no corresponding 怎 row was established.
